name: Sobor (Hungary)
description: White field with a serrated border of red and green triangles, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Sobor: a crowned green and red shield with a ploughshare, a fish, a church and a tree, within a green wreath, above a scroll inscribed SOBOR.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
